name: p2e
description: P2E authoring + workflow commands for Claude Code. Adds /p2e-bootstrap, /p2e-add-story, /p2e-update-story, /p2e-work-on-next, /p2e-sync-labels, /p2e-bind, /p2e-html, /p2e-md, and /p2e-md-to-html, plus the writing-rich-html-docs skill for opinionated rich-HTML doc rendering. Backed by the p2e MCP. Use /p2e-bind once per repo to anchor it to a P2E project for automatic slug calibration.
